svg.text: Buses from March to nearby places
runs as two arms — to Manea and to Wisbech.
Find where you want to go, around the edge of the diagram.
Follow its coloured line in to March at the centre.
The badge on that line is the bus service number.
Routes & stops: UK Bus Open Data Service (Open Government Licence v3.0), cross-checked with operators at bustimes.org (June 2026).
Confirm live times & fares at bustimes.org or operator apps. Journey times shown are approximate. Diagram — not to scale.
